preferences.text: Interested in the potential of AI in medical diagnosis and its application in healthcare
Interested in learning more about AI-powered diagnosis of rare diseases
Believes AI can democratize access to healthcare, especially for patients with rare diseases and those in remote or underserved areas
Believes AI can reduce healthcare disparities through personalized treatment plans tailored to individual patients' needs
Believes AI can enable remote monitoring and telemedicine, particularly benefiting patients with mobility issues or difficulty accessing healthcare facilities
Believes AI systems should be designed and deployed equitably, transparently, and fairly, while addressing data bias, algorithmic fairness, and lack of representation
